title: Alere Mycobacterium Tuberculosis Urine Study
brief_summary: Current molecular methods will be evaluated for the detection of Mycobacterium tuberculosis specific nucleic acid in urine and blood of patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Suspected or confirmed tuberculosis
* Age \>18 years
* informed consent obtained

Exclusion Criteria:

* Previous participation in the study
* Simultaneous participation in a clinical trial investigating a new drug
* Inability to give consent
* Member of a vulnerable study population
study_population: Patients with suspected or confirmed tuberculosis
